meta.name: agent-teams
meta.description: Coordinate multiple Claude Code sessions as a team — lead + teammates with shared task lists, mailbox messaging, and file-lock claiming. Patterns for team sizing, task decomposition, and when to use teams vs sub-agents vs worktrees.

copy.tagline: 协调多个 Claude Code 会话组成团队协作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个 Claude Code 会话间分配任务并协同工作
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate multiple Claude Code sessions as a team
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to distribute tasks and collaborate across multiple Claude Code sessions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 可以协调多个 Claude Code 会话组成团队，包括一个领导者和多个队友，共享任务列表、邮箱和文件锁，实现并行协作。
howto.when: 当你在终端中设置环境变量并启动 Claude Code 时，第一个会话成为团队领导，后续在同一仓库启动的会话自动加入为队友。

say.text: 我们团队需要实现速率限制，分解成4个任务。
say.note: 领导会创建任务并分配给队友。

say.text: 切换到委托模式，我只做协调。
say.note: 领导不再直接编辑代码，只审批计划和任务。

say.text: 检查队友2的当前任务和输出。
say.note: 按 Shift+Down 可循环查看各队友状态。

howto.what_en: Claude can coordinate multiple Claude Code sessions as a team with a lead and teammates, sharing a task list, mailbox, and file locks for parallel collaboration.
howto.when_en: When you set the environment variable and start Claude Code, the first session becomes the team lead; subsequent sessions in the same repo join as teammates automatically.

say_en.text: We need rate limiting, break it into 4 tasks.
say_en.note: Lead creates tasks and assigns to teammates.

say_en.text: Switch to delegate mode, I only coordinate.
say_en.note: Lead stops editing code, only reviews plans and tasks.

say_en.text: Check teammate 2's current task and output.
say_en.note: Press Shift+Down to cycle through teammates.
